description: Verify that Subscribe with TCP Endpoint option and no live TCP connection — DUT must respond with SubscribeEventgroupNack
approach:
[Objective]
Defensive nack: DUT must verify the TCP connection exists before acking a TCP-bound Subscribe — otherwise events would have nowhere to go.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService with IPv4 endpoint.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with TCP option, but no TCP handshake first.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SubscribeNack (TTL=0).

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT nacked TCP subscribe without connection — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_with_endpoint: No OfferService with IPv4 endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_dut_acked_tcp_subscribe_with: DUT acked TCP subscribe without pre-established connection
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_subscribe_response: No subscribe response within listen window
